diagnosis: BackupTokenManagementViewSet exposes unused static 2FA backup codes through the backup_codes action. Because StaticDevice.objects.get(pk=pk) performs an unscoped query without verifying device.user == request.user, any authenticated user can enumerate static device IDs to harvest plaintext emergency backup codes for other users, completely bypassing multi-factor authentication.
